title: kill_bonus_damage
description: Killing mobs increases the damage of the equipped weapon.
body:
When a player kills a mob using equipment with the c:tools tag, the damage of the weapon in their hand is increased. For mobs with HP ≥ 200, each kill adds 0.1 damage; for mobs with HP > 5000, each kill adds 5 damage; for mobs with HP > 10000, each kill adds 10 damage. The maximum damage increase is capped at 1000.
This option is configurable.
